comments: Accessibility checks are one part of the tool. They do not replace a full manual WCAG audit, and the report says so clearly. Interface in Ukrainian and English.
features: Online checker for site owners: 13 automated checks in about a minute, including basic accessibility (page language, title, image alt text, form labels, h1, zoom, Google Lighthouse accessibility score). Results in plain language. Free score; paid full report.
title: OLBO Website Checker
